children: SurgePays' revenue fell 7.57% year over year, while earnings improved from a loss to income. Lower MVNO revenue, following a pause in new Lifeline user intake amid an audit delay, was partly offset by higher Point-of-Sale and Prepaid Services revenue; reported earnings included a $27.2M gain on the ClearLine asset sale.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) available to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Fell 62.6% as an audit delay led the Eligible Telecommunications Carrier to pause new user intake in late 2025, reducing Lifeline revenue in early 2026.
: Revenue rose $2.0M, attributed to continued scaling efforts and increased use of the sales force.
: The platform assets were sold on September 10 for preferred stock and a put option; SurgePays recorded a $27.2M gain.
: The company expects to focus on improving Point-of-Sale and Prepaid Services margins and aims to return MVNO to positive results in late 2026.
